text: I've finished the careers and missions runs, and I'm waiting on the other three pages. The Artemis III and NACA runs are in progress and the KSC history run is queued.

Only some criteria got a firm result. I ran the automated Trusted Tester checks on all five pages. Many criteria are still NEEDS_REVIEW because the tool couldn't settle them. These results are agent-assisted and not a certified Trusted Tester result.

**Failures on every page**
- **2.4.1 Bypass Blocks:** I found no keyboard way to skip the repeated header (Explore, Search, News & Events, Multimedia) on any page except the NACA page. There the tool tried only 8 possible skip methods, so it's NEEDS_REVIEW. A "Skip to main content" link is missing.
- **3.3.2 Labels or Instructions:** The header "Search" text field has only gray placeholder text as its label, which disappears when someone types. This fails on all five pages.

**Passes and review items**
- **2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap:** This passed on all five pages. Collapsed menus and accordions weren't opened, so their contents weren't checked for traps.
- **3.2.3 Consistent Navigation:** This passed on all five pages.
- **3.2.4 Consistent Identification:** This passed on all five pages. On the careers and Artemis III pages, I judged the different top-menu items (for example "Featured Careers" and "Artemis") as separate controls, not inconsistent names.
- **2.4.5 Multiple Ways:** The tool found only the site search as a way to reach each page. For the missions and NACA pages it found no way at all. I did not run the follow-up that adds the home page and sitemap, so this stays NEEDS_REVIEW everywhere.
- **2.4.7 Focus Visible:** The tool couldn't confirm focus visibility for many elements, including "Close" in the pop-up. The Artemis III and NACA runs came back FAIL, but with no specific failing elements I could name, so I report them as NEEDS_REVIEW. The NACA elements it flagged (the skip-style links and "Share this story") were never in view.
- **2.4.3 Focus Order:** The feedback pop-up ("Was this page helpful?") is reached in an odd order: Submit, then Close, and Shift+Tab doesn't reverse it. Other pages also had order jumps. I answered "unsure", so a person needs to check.
- **2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide:** The tool saw timers and server polling on every page, and on the NACA page some content moves by itself. I did not answer the NACA page's open movement questions, so a person should watch each page for a minute.
- **3.3.1, 3.3.3 and 3.3.4 (error and prevention criteria):** On the careers page these are DNA because the only form is the feedback pop-up, which showed no errors. The NACA and KSC pages are DNA for 3.3.1 and 3.3.3 because their only form is a site search that accepts anything. KSC is also DNA for 3.3.4. On the NACA page the 3.3.4 question was never answered, so it stays NEEDS_REVIEW. On the missions and Artemis III pages, the form checks couldn't be completed.
- **1.3.1 and 4.1.2 (form fields):** KSC passes both. On the missions page 98 form fields remained unjudged, so it stays NEEDS_REVIEW. On the Artemis III and NACA pages, form fields inside frames weren't checked, so those also stay NEEDS_REVIEW.
- **2.4.6 Headings and Labels (form labels):** I left this NEEDS_REVIEW on every page. The tool said DNA for careers and KSC because it saw no visible labels, but the search field does have an accessible name.
